name: The Gambit
author: Addicting Games
description: Dive into the chessboard chaos of The Gambit! Play as animated chess pieces in this puzzle game where brains beat brawn. Solve tricky puzzles, outwit opponents, and navigate the board strategically. With vibrant visuals and brain-teasing challenges, it's a fast-paced, playful quest for chess mastery. Will you checkmate your way to victory and be the ultimate chess maestro? The pieces are set, the game is on – let the Gambit begin!
